description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDittoGraphStageLogic' that extends Akka Streams' 'GraphStageLogicWithLogging'. It provides a custom method 'passAlongMapConcat' with a handler 'PassAlongMapConcatHandler' for passing and transforming stream elements within an Akka Streams processing graph, adding Ditto-specific functionality.

classes.name: AbstractDittoGraphStageLogic
classes.description: An abstract class extending Akka's GraphStageLogicWithLogging, adding Ditto-specific stream processing methods.

methods.name: passAlongMapConcat
methods.description: A method that passes elements from an inlet to an outlet after applying a mapping function that outputs multiple elements, with handling for already available or closed streams.
